summary: Wesley Quinlan and Wiyanna Nelson, both 19, were swept away by floodwaters the evening of September 11, 2013 while returning from a birthday party northwest of Boulder; their car became stuck in a mudslide and they left the vehicle
notes: Quinlan's body was recovered Thursday 2013-09-12, Nelson's Friday 2013-09-13; memorial service 2013-09-21 at NCAR in Boulder; Boulder Daily Camera origin of the stuck-car/mudslide account; September 2013 Front Range flood
